approval.approved_scope: sampler-only audit of boundary-distance background strata; no model, loss, training, decoder or live change

scope.single_experimental_change: replace only the uniform background component of Experiment 12 by exact nearest-boundary-distance background strata and audit a preregistered one-dimensional quota grid

locked_contract.multiplicity: one position with count k remains one draw opportunity with target k

background_partition.distance_reference: nearest onset or internal offset boundary in the same track
background_partition.distance_2_to_15: nearest distance from 2 through 15 samples inclusive
background_partition.distance_16_to_63: nearest distance from 16 through 63 samples inclusive
background_partition.partition_requirement: the four background strata are exhaustive, disjoint and sum exactly to the locked Experiment 12 background pool
background_partition.sampling_within_each_stratum: uniform over all eligible global track/sample positions with replacement
background_partition.implementation_constraint: uniform global-frame rejection sampling; no audio decoding

fixed_draws.independent_rng_streams: positive and each background stratum use deterministic derived seeds; candidate draws are prefixes so unchanged strata remain comparable

validation_background_counts.distance_64_plus: 133 minus the other validation background counts

preregistered_grid.selection_uses: train analytical and structural guards only
preregistered_grid.validation_use: report the preregistered corresponding draw only; never select h from validation results
preregistered_grid.selection_rule: choose the smallest h in the locked order that passes every selection gate; if none passes, select none

prior_diagnostic.live_stratum_probability: p_s = full-stream positions in stratum s / all full-stream positions
prior_diagnostic.sampled_stratum_probability: q_s = fixed draws in stratum s / fixed queries
prior_diagnostic.normalization: sum_s q_s*w_s must equal one analytically
prior_diagnostic.use: audit only; importance weights are not approved as a training loss

required_before_after_audit: exact full-stream position counts for every new background stratum
sum and disjointness against Experiment 12 background
fixed draw counts and exact distance validation
selected unique positions and repeated draws
unweighted joint and per-head exact-count histograms
analytical importance-weighted joint prior and mean weight
importance-weight range and effective sample size
constant categorical optimum and positive/negative diagnostic mass
rare count 2 and 3 exposure unchanged from Experiment 12
comparison of every grid candidate to Experiment 12

interpretation_guards.hard_negative_causality: greater adjacent-negative exposure is a sampler fact; reduction of broad or isolated model predictions remains unproved until a later compatible training experiment
interpretation_guards.rare_counts: this experiment deliberately does not repair count-2 or count-3 exposure
interpretation_guards.unweighted_prior: positive draw counts remain unchanged, so the approximately one-third positive batch prior remains uncalibrated for live use
interpretation_guards.importance_weights: analytical correction may estimate the live distribution but is not selected as a loss
interpretation_guards.crop_live_equivalence: remains unverified because no compatible point-query model exists
interpretation_guards.training_readiness: cannot pass in this experiment because rare-count exposure, loss selection, crop implementation and crop/live equality remain unresolved
